papers.title: [Demo] Conditional sparsity under bounded distribution shift
papers.abstract: Synthetic fixture content used to exercise the paper audit interface.
papers.evidenceSummary: In this illustrative record, the narrow latency claim reproduced within tolerance, while generalization beyond the reported shift remains untested.
papers.selectionReason: The reported gain was specific, testable, and potentially enabled by cheaper edge inference.
papers.authorsClaim: The authors report stable accuracy with materially lower conditional compute under one bounded shift family.
papers.evidenceSupports: The fixture audit supports only the reported benchmark and shift family, not broad robustness.
papers.strongestEvidence: A seed-controlled rerun landed within one percentage point of the reported accuracy and reproduced the compute reduction.
papers.strongestCounterevidence: No independent group or unseen shift family is available in this fixture.
papers.integrityStatus: No correction or formal integrity notice appears in the illustrative record.
papers.replicationStatus: One internal sandbox reproduction; independent replication is unknown.
papers.decisiveNextCheck: Evaluate the gating policy on a temporally separated dataset with a fixed compute budget.
papers.dossierMarkdown:
## Scoped verdict

This is **demo data**, not a claim about a real paper. The interface keeps the author claim separate from what the sandbox run directly supports.

## Claim-to-evidence table

| Claim | Evidence | Boundary | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accuracy is retained | Seed-controlled rerun | One synthetic shift family | Single-origin support |
| Compute is reduced | Operation count artifact | Same implementation | Reproduced |
| Robustness generalizes | No evidence attached | Unseen shifts | Unknown |

## Reproducibility

The attempt used an offline container, a fixed seed, a pinned image digest, and immutable evidence hashes.

papers.title: [Demo] Reusable routing policies for low-power inference
papers.evidenceSummary: The example audit found a real signal, but gains collapsed under compute-matched baselines and seed variance was not bounded.
papers.selectionReason: The work is under-cited and proposes a reusable component rather than a full product.
papers.authorsClaim: A learned router transfers across model families without retuning.
papers.evidenceSupports: Transfer is visible for two related models, with weak baseline parity.
papers.strongestEvidence: Ablations isolate the routing component on the primary benchmark.
papers.strongestCounterevidence: Compute-matched baselines recover most of the stated improvement.
papers.integrityStatus: No formal notice is represented in this demo.
papers.decisiveNextCheck: Rerun with compute-matched baselines and five prespecified seeds.

papers.title: [Demo] Ambient-field calibration in compact spin sensors
papers.evidenceSummary: The illustrative calibration mechanism has transparent methods and convergent support from two independent-origin records.
papers.selectionReason: An older method may now be practical because control electronics are cheaper and smaller.
papers.authorsClaim: A reference sequence removes a dominant ambient-field error without cryogenic control.
papers.evidenceSupports: The calibration effect persists across the documented temperature and field range.
papers.strongestEvidence: Two independent-origin examples converge on the same error-cancellation mechanism.
papers.strongestCounterevidence: Long-duration drift outside the reported operating range remains unknown.
papers.integrityStatus: No correction or formal notice is represented in this demo.
papers.replicationStatus: Independent convergent support is represented for the bounded mechanism.
papers.decisiveNextCheck: Run a 30-day drift test in a target deployment enclosure.

papers.integrityStatus: No integrity verdict is issued for an abstract-only record.
papers.decisiveNextCheck: Obtain the full benchmark protocol and contamination audit.

opportunities.title: [Demo] Shift-aware inference verification kit
opportunities.oneLine: A verification harness for teams adopting conditional compute under real distribution shifts.
opportunities.unexploredness: NOT FOUND IN SEARCH - LIMITED COVERAGE
opportunities.bindingConstraint: Evidence that ML platform teams will pay for a dedicated verification workflow rather than extend existing observability tools.
opportunities.whyNow: Conditional inference is reaching deployment while evaluation remains benchmark-centric.
opportunities.demonstrated: The bounded compute and accuracy claim can be checked reproducibly in an isolated environment.
opportunities.inference: Teams may value a reusable pre-deployment verification workflow across model and shift families.
opportunities.priorArt: The illustrative sweep found evaluation libraries and observability products, but did not complete a procurement or patent search.
opportunities.decisiveExperiment: Recruit five ML platform teams and ask each to run one real deployment candidate through a manual concierge audit.
opportunities.killCriterion: Drop if fewer than two teams provide a live model and dataset or none will pay for a second audit.
risks: Existing observability vendors can absorb the workflow
Customer data may not be movable
opportunities.reportMarkdown:
## Decision

Keep in **test** until buyer behavior, not compliments, establishes value.

## Wedge

Start with a reproducibility packet for one conditional inference release: pinned environment, prespecified thresholds, shift slices, and immutable evidence hashes.

reports.title: [Demo] Adaptive sparsity radar / August 2
reports.summary: One bounded claim reproduced; one verification-tool wedge remains worth a buyer test.
reports.markdown:
# Bottom line

This is **illustrative fixture content**. The strongest demo record reproduced a narrow accuracy claim, but independent support and buyer evidence remain missing.

## Coverage and honesty statement

- Two illustrative indexes
- 148 records returned
- 46 screened
- 3 audited
- Baseline still in progress

## What changed today

The verification-kit opportunity moved from watch to test after the sandbox attempt produced a bounded pass.

## Unknowns

Independent-origin reproduction, temporal shift behavior, patent coverage, and paid buyer behavior remain unknown.

reports.title: [Demo] Room-temperature quantum sensing landscape
reports.summary: A mechanism-first map of calibration, packaging, readout, and field-deployment bottlenecks.
reports.markdown:
# Landscape

This demo map separates mechanism evidence from deployment readiness.

## Layers

1. Sensing mechanism
2. Calibration and control
3. Packaging and drift
4. Readout and workflow integration

## Frontier question

Can a narrow reference module make long-duration field stability measurable before a complete sensor product is built?

reports.title: [Demo] Persistent agent memory market check
reports.summary: The problem is visible, but this fixture does not establish urgency, budget ownership, or a differentiated wedge.
reports.markdown:
# Decision

**Continue discovery; do not build yet.**

## Evidence

The demo record contains workflow pain but no paid behavior. Existing platforms can plausibly absorb the feature.

## Next test

Observe five production incident reviews where memory failure was load-bearing, then seek precommitment for a replay and audit tool.

reports.title: [Demo] Agent memory: a mastery path
reports.summary: A progressive learning route from retrieval primitives to temporal evaluation and production failure analysis.
reports.markdown:
# Mastery path

## Foundation

Explain the difference between context, retrieval, state, and durable memory without product vocabulary.

## Practice

Build a temporal evaluation where the correct answer depends on an earlier state transition rather than semantic similarity.

## Frontier

Design an audit that distinguishes retrieval failure, stale state, policy error, and contaminated memory.
